g.text: Facade sill tray — 2 mm physical front edge-break lookdev
Implementation brief only. Final acceptance requires native 3840×2160 frontal / oblique / grazing pixels plus temporal LOD evidence.
Section through tray depth (not to scale)
front top break = 2 mm authored assumption
front bottom break = 2 mm authored assumption
• Extruded/anodized aluminum: remove mathematical knife edge with real macro geometry, not a normal-map trick.
• Keep lower-frame seat, drain recess, 50 mm physical openings, skirt and drip nose unchanged.
• Inherit MAT_AgedAluminum: metallic 0.82–0.94, roughness 0.43–0.55, dry wetness 0.
• Rebuild combined LOD1/2/3 proxy from the refined five-piece LOD0 assembly; never let edge geometry vanish at distance.
Frontal: no decorative bright line. Oblique: frame-seat/recess unchanged. Grazing: finite moving highlight, no faceting or painted rim.
Temporal: no highlight-centroid snap, silhouette pop, shimmer or proxy mismatch through LOD0→1→2→3 cross-fades.
Visual Fidelity points awarded by this lookdev: 0. Render verification pending.
